title: Credit approval policy
content:
A credit memo is issued only against an open dispute, and never for more than the amount in dispute. Before any credit, the claim is checked against evidence: proof of delivery for a shortage, a damage report for damaged goods, the pricing agreement for a price claim. A claim the evidence contradicts is rejected, however small.
Credits up to and including $500.00 that the evidence supports are applied without further approval. Credits above $500.00 are applied only after the AR lead approves them. A credit the AR lead rejects is neither applied nor proposed again.
